lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee chha(n)t mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Chhant, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀਉ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun naah prabhoo jeeu ekalaRee ban maahe ||
lines.translation: Hear me, O my Dear Husband God - I am all alone in the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈਗੀ ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu dheeraigee naah binaa prabh veparavaahe ||
lines.translation: How can I find comfort without You, O my Carefree Husband God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਨਾਹ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਰੈਣਿ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan naah baajhahu rahi na saakai bikham rain ghanereeaa ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; the night is so painful for her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਨੀਦ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah need aavai prem bhaavai sun bena(n)tee mereeaa ||
lines.translation: Sleep does not come. I am in love with my Beloved. Please, listen to my prayer!

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਰੇ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਕੁਰਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: baajhahu piaare koi na saare ekalaRee kuralaae ||
lines.translation: Other than my Beloved, no one cares for me; I cry all alone in the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee bin preetam dukh paae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the bride meets Him when He causes her to meet Him; without her Beloved, she suffers in pain. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਜੀਉ ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir chhodiaRee jeeu kavan milaavai ||
lines.translation: She is separated from her Husband Lord - who can unite her with Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras prem milee jeeu sabad suhaavai ||
lines.translation: Tasting His Love, she meets Him, through the Beautiful Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਹ ਉਜਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade suhaavai taa pat paavai deepak deh ujaarai ||
lines.translation: Adorned with the Shabad, she obtains her Husband, and her body is illuminated with the lamp of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakhee sahelee saach suhelee saache ke gun saarai ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my friends and companions - she who is at peace dwells upon the True Lord and His True Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur melee taa pir raavee bigasee a(n)mrit baanee ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, she is ravished and enjoyed by her Husband Lord; she blossoms forth with the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saa dhan taa pir raave jaa tis kai man bhaanee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Husband Lord enjoys His bride when she is pleasing to His Mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਨੀਘਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohanee neeghareeaa jeeu kooR muthee kooRiaare ||
lines.translation: Fascination with Maya made her homeless; the false are cheated by falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਖੂਲੈ ਗਲ ਜੇਵੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu khoolai gal jevaReeaa jeeu bin gur at piaare ||
lines.translation: How can the noose around her neck be untied, without the Most Beloved Guru?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har preet piaare sabad veechaare tis hee kaa so hovai ||
lines.translation: One who loves the Beloved Lord, and reflects upon the Shabad, belongs to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਨਾਵਣ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pu(n)n daan anek naavan kiu a(n)tar mal dhovai ||
lines.translation: How can giving donations to charities and countless cleansing baths wash off the filth within the heart?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa gat koi na paavai hath nigrahi bebaanai ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, no one attains salvation. Stubborn self-discipline and living in the wilderness are of no use at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach ghar sabad sinjaapai dubidhaa mahal k jaanai ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the home of Truth is attained through the Shabad. How can the Mansion of His Presence be known through duality? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam sachaa jeeu sabad sachaa veechaaro ||
lines.translation: True is Your Name, O Dear Lord; True is contemplation of Your Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa mahal sachaa jeeu naam sachaa vaapaaro ||
lines.translation: True is the Mansion of Your Presence, O Dear Lord, and True is trade in Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam kaa vaapaar meethaa bhagat laahaa anadino ||
lines.translation: Trade in Your Name is very sweet; the devotees earn this profit night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis baajh vakhar koi na soojhai naam levahu khin khino ||
lines.translation: Other than this, I can think of no other merchandise. So chant the Naam each and every moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਖਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: parakh lekhaa nadar saachee karam poorai paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The account is read; by the Grace of the True Lord and good karma, the Perfect Lord is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam mahaa ras meethaa gur poorai sach paaiaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Nectar of the Name is so sweet. Through the Perfect True Guru, it is obtained. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee chha(n)t mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan binau kare jeeu har ke gun saare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride offers her prayers to her Dear Lord; she dwells upon His Glorious Virtues.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal rahi na sakai jeeu bin har piaare ||
lines.translation: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har piaare rahi na saakai gur bin mahal na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: She cannot live without her Beloved Lord; without the Guru, the Mansion of His Presence is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo gur kahai soee par keejai tisanaa agan bujhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Guru says, she should surely do, to extinguish the fire of desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har saachaa soee tis bin avar na koee bin seviai sukh na paae ||
lines.translation: The Lord is True; there is no one except Him. Without serving Him, peace is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saa dhan milai milaaee jis no aap milaae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride, whom the Lord Himself unites, is united with Him; He Himself merges with her. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan rain suhelaReee jeeu har siu chit laae ||
lines.translation: The life-night of the soul-bride is blessed and joyful, when she focuses her consciousness on her Dear Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve bhaau kare jeeu vichahu aap gavaae ||
lines.translation: She serves the True Guru with love; she eradicates selfishness from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap gavaae har gun gaae anadin laagaa bhaao ||
lines.translation: Eradicating selfishness and conceit from within, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, she is in love with the Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakhee sahelee jee kee melee gur kai sabad samaao ||
lines.translation: Listen, dear friends and companions of the soul - immerse yourselves in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
